name: DispatchConsole
concept: The police radio dispatch desk set of the St Philippe station: a low sloping console that sits on the duty desk, with a row of channel buttons, a speaker, a handset in a cradle and a stubby desk microphone. The dispatcher takes calls from it.
prompt: Late-1980s police radio dispatch desk console: a low wide sloping-front cabinet of beige and grey plastic and metal, a speaker grille on the left, rows of push buttons and toggle switches with small indicator lamps on the sloping panel, a coiled-cord handset resting in a cradle on the right side, a short stubby desk microphone on a heavy round base at the front. no text, no logos.
